name: gridline-workspace
description: Gridline from-scratch Rust/WASM Excel viewer workspace

scripts.lint: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @gridline/demo lint && pnpm --filter gridline-viewer exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter gridline-viewer test && pnpm --filter @gridline/demo test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter gridline-viewer exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @gridline/demo typecheck
